item.title: Separating the Wayland Compositor and Window Manager
item.description:

item.title: Show HN: GDSL – 800 line kernel: Lisp subset in 500, C subset in 1300
item.description:
📝 Any small compiler gets small by making tradeoffs, it constrains itself to a shape small enough that it fits, or simply doesn’t implement the features. They’re just 3 weeks of work reconstructing what a language can mean. Which made me ask: what are these other compilers doing that add the million lines.
🔗 Read more: https://firthemouse.github.io/

item.title: Learning athletic humanoid tennis skills from imperfect human motion data
item.description:
📝 Human athletes demonstrate versatile and highly-dynamic tennis skills to successfully conduct competitive rallies with a high-speed tennis ball. In this work, we propose LATENT, a system that Learns Athletic humanoid TEnnis skills from imperfect human motioN daTa. The imperfect human motion data consist only of motion fragments that capture the primitive skills used when playing tennis rather than precise and complete human-tennis motion sequences from real-world tennis matches, thereby significantly reducing the difficulty of data collection.
🔗 Read more: https://zzk273.github.io/LATENT/
